senses.sense_definition: Het gevoel van verbondenheid met de medemensen of de gemeenschap waartoe men behoort.

examples.text: Er is in dit dorp een sterke <w>gemeenschapszin</w> onder de bewoners.

target_lang_translations.en: There is a strong <w>community spirit</w> among the residents in this village.

examples.text: Door samen vrijwilligerswerk te doen, versterken we de <w>gemeenschapszin</w> in de buurt.

target_lang_translations.en: By doing volunteer work together, we strengthen the <w>sense of community</w> in the neighborhood.

target_lang_definitions.en: The feeling of connection with fellow human beings or the community to which one belongs.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The shared feeling of belonging and mutual support within a local group or neighborhood.
The psychological sense of belonging and shared identity among members of a group.
Unity or agreement of feeling or action, especially among individuals with a common interest.
